newsitem.title: TURKEY: SOCCER SHOWCASE-FENERBAHCE SACK COACH LAZARONI.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-FENERBAHCE SACK COACH LAZARONI.

text.p: Istanbul soccer club Fenerbahce sacked their Brazilian coach Sebastiao Lazaroni on Thursday after the team lost in a cup derby on Wednesday night, the Anatolian news agency said.
The sacking followed Fenerbahce's 2-1 defeat by Istanbul rivals Besiktas who were playing with 10 men.
"If we can't beat Besiktas with 10 men, we can't hide behind bad luck, or any other excuse," club director Vefa Kucuk said.

Lazaroni was attacked for changes made to the previously championship-winning team and the lack of results since the new year which has seen Fenerbahce score only two league goals and lose against lowly Altay.
The club are said to be negotiating with Senol Gunes, who resigned as coach of the Black Sea team Trabzonspor after a similar defeat by Besiktas on Saturday.
Fenerbahce are currently lying in second place in the Turkish league with 44 points, three points behind Galatasaray who they play on Sunday in one of the clashes of the season.
Besiktas and Trabzonspor are in third and fourth positions, both on 42 points.
